tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends after each player has played 20 turns (when no face-down Habitat Tile can replace the taken one). Wildlife card point values depend on the card variant (A-D, Family/Intermediate) chosen, so each animal is a scorer-entered number. Corridor points are 1 per tile in the largest corridor; the majority categories take the same sizes again (enter each size once there, and the sum in corridorPoints). Majority bonus: 2 players 2 pts to largest (tie 1 each, none for second); 3-4 players 3 to largest, 1 to second; tie for largest 2 each (2 tied) or 1 each (3-4 tied) with nothing for next; ties for second 0. Solo: no majority; instead 2 bonus pts per habitat with corridor of 7+ (not modelled, add by hand) and compare to score ladder (60+ ... 110+). Rolling Rivers expansion and scenarios not modelled.
